scripts.build:slew: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const dir='out'; fs.rmSync(dir,{recursive:true,force:true}); fs.mkdirSync(dir+'/server',{recursive:true}); fs.cpSync('index.js',dir+'/server/index.js'); if(fs.existsSync('data.dat')) fs.cpSync('data.dat',dir+'/server/data.dat'); fs.cpSync('package.json',dir+'/package.json'); fs.writeFileSync(dir+'/slew.json', JSON.stringify({ server: 'server/index.js', runtime: 'node22' }, null, 2))" && npm --prefix out install --omit=dev
